conditions: Inquiry requires inspecting account email, username, payment card, or invoice number
Public Twitter disclosure of private credentials must be avoided

conditions: Intent is SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING and user mentions post-cancellation charge, double charge, or refund request

conditions: Customer reports unfamiliar email change, unauthorized password reset, or foreign login
escalation_triggers.dm_message: We take account security seriously. Please DM us your registered email address right away so we can secure your account.

conditions: Customer has already executed clean reinstall or cache clearing and issue persists
escalation_triggers.dm_message: Thanks for trying those steps. Could you DM us your device model, OS version, and Spotify version so our tech specialists can investigate?

conditions: Customer expresses acute frustration, severe profanity, or threatening to delete app
escalation_triggers.dm_message: We're genuinely sorry for this distressing experience. Please send us a DM so our customer relations team can assist you directly.
